description: A retro-inspired chandelier with a yellow conical top extending downwards via a light blue rod. Below this, a light pink sphere acts as a central hub from which thin yellow wires extend outwards. These wires attach to a light blue circular ring, which is suspended by the wires. Eight magenta, trumpet-shaped shades with ribbed textures are attached to the outer edge of this ring, pointing upwards and slightly outwards. The overall design evokes a mid-century modern aesthetic, likely intended to be a statement lighting fixture.
